name: Lärchenwiese
beschreibung: Campingplatz Lärchenwiese is located in Tirol, Österreich, at an altitude of around 1,200 meters. The site is surrounded by larch forests and alpine meadows. The atmosphere is quiet and close to nature. The facilities include sanitary buildings, a shop, and pitches with electricity connections. In the surrounding area there are hiking trails and a ski area. Guests can go on mountain tours and nature explorations here. The site is suitable for independent travelers and families. The season runs from May to October, sometimes also in winter.
